name: Jojo and the Spring Horn Mystery
shortDescription: Jojo and Dudu follow a trail of shapes, distances, fractions and patterns across the Village of Many Shapes to solve the mystery of Chief Short and Round’s missing spring horn.
longDescription: When Chief Short and Round announces that his spring horn has disappeared, Little Square Jojo volunteers to find it before the spring celebration begins. With Dudu Diamond as his co-investigator, Jojo follows an illustrated route through the Village of Many Shapes, visiting Tata Rectangle’s house, Jojo’s square home, Dudu’s diamond-patterned house and Mama Triangle’s mountain home. Along the way, the children use distance, addition and subtraction, halves, quarters, shape recognition, a six-sided hexagonal spiderweb, estimation and map-reading to keep the investigation moving. At the end of the journey, Mama Triangle reveals the comic truth: the chief has been wearing the horn on his head all day. Jojo is rewarded by sounding the horn to begin a spring festival filled with repeating patterns, symmetry and geometric formations.

attribution.author: Leo Daly
attribution.adaptationNote: Adapted for animation by Panda Kids Club. Changes were made, including strengthening Dudu Diamond as a co-investigator, adding a recurring illustrated route map, making the mathematical ideas more visually explicit through distances, fractions, geometric patterns and physical route clues, placing the missing horn subtly on the chief’s head as a recurring visual joke, and expanding the spring-festival ending with repeating patterns, symmetry and geometric formations.
